caseName: Davis ex rel. LaShonda D. v. Monroe County Board of Education
caseNameFull: Davis, as Next Friend of LaShonda D. v. Monroe County Board of Education

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Certiorari granted limited to Question 1 presented by the petition. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, November 10, 1998. Brief of respondents is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, December 8, 1998. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, December 29, 1998. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
